# 1940 monthly national defense values
vals_1940 = [132, 129, 143, 159, 154, 153, 177, 200, 219, 287, 376, 473]
sum_1940 = sum(vals_1940)
print(f"1940 Total: {sum_1940} million")

# 1953 monthly national defense values

sum_1953 = sum(vals_1953)
print(f"1953 Total: {sum_1953} million")

# Calculate absolute percent difference
# Formula: |1953 - 1940| / ((1953 + 1940) / 2) * 100
abs_diff = abs(sum_1953 - sum_1940)
avg = (sum_1953 + sum_1940) / 2
pct_diff = (abs_diff / avg) * 100

print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff}")
print(f"Average: {avg}")
print(f"Absolute percent difference: {pct_diff:.2f}%")
EOF
